pages.text: A linked pair teleports an [[ender_minecart]] and its rider from one to the other, keeping its speed.

**Linking:** place one rail; hold another and right-click the placed one when it sparkles. The held rail is now **attuned** (its tooltip shows where). Place it to link the pair. Linked rails have **lit** eyes.

Same dimension, within 64 blocks. Each rail links to one other; breaking either unlinks both.

**Teleporting:** a moving ender minecart on a linked rail jumps to its partner, keeping speed, and turns **right** if the partner runs crosswise. It then waits 3 seconds before teleporting again. A stopped cart stays put.

Other minecarts roll over unless the config allows them.
